LanguageData.ABY_DominionSigilDisabled: Dominion sigils remain sealed unless the circle is allowed to handle dominion-class rites.
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_Dominion_Desc: Consumes one dominion sigil and uses the full circle lattice to arm the Great Infernal Gate prelude. Dominion anchors now stabilize the breach as a short external gate-lock instead of acting as a long destruction objective. Once synchronization completes, the gate opens for a selected strike team to enter the pocket dimension.
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_Dominion_Rewards: • Initializes the endgame dominion framework in-world • Manifests four external anchors as a short visual gate-lock • Opens a real Great Infernal Gate for controlled strike-team entry • Preserves reward routing, shard recovery and gate-state records for deeper entry rites
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_Dominion_SideEffects: • Requires full stabilizer coverage and both capacitor bays online • Blocks other abyssal encounters while the dominion staging layer is active • External anchors collapse automatically when the pocket dimension closes by victory, failure, extraction, cancellation, or cleanup
